text: The Manager, Cycling Infrastructure and Programs, Transportation Services and the Project Manager, Infrastructure Planning, Cycling Infrastructure and Programs, Transportation Services will provide an overview of the concept designs planned for the permanent cycletracks.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends to the Executive Committee that: 1. The comments and recommendations in the submission (April 18, 2018) from Walk Toronto, Steering Committee on the proposed design options for Bloor Street Bike Lanes, be referred to the General Manager, Transportation Services, for consideration during the detailed design of the permanent Bloor Street Bike lanes.
